map.小儿推拿剂量换算器，按小儿年龄换算推拿次数、时间与力度，提供常用穴位剂量指导，规: The pediatric tuina dose converter turns a child's age into tuina session count, duration and intensity, gives dosing guidance for common acupoints, and standardizes pediatric tuina practice.
map.婴幼儿补脾经，次数多于大龄儿童。: For infants and toddlers, tonify the spleen meridian more often than for older children.
map.发热清天河水，按年龄定操作时长。: For fever, clear the channels with warmed water, and set the duration by age.
map.腹泻摩腹，力度轻、频率稳。: For diarrhea, rub the abdomen with light force and a steady rhythm.
map.：2 岁患儿脾虚，补脾经（拇指桡侧）约 300 次、摩腹 5 分钟、力度轻柔如抚: A 2-year-old with spleen deficiency: tonify the spleen meridian (radial side of the thumb) about 300 times and rub the abdomen for 5 minutes with gentle, stroking force; a 6-year-old needs about 500 repetitions and 8-10 minutes, increasing with age, until the skin turns slightly pink.
map.穴位配伍（开四关）组合推荐: Acupoint combination recommendation (opening the four gates)
map.小儿推拿次数为什么按年龄？: Why is the tuina session count based on age?
map.小儿「稚阴稚阳」，剂量随年龄、体质增减，过小无效、过则伤正；本工具给参考区间。: Children have "delicate yin and yang", so the dose rises and falls with age and constitution; too little has no effect and too much harms the body. This tool gives a reference range.
map.常用爽身粉、按摩油润滑防擦伤，冬温手、避风寒；严重病症请就医。: Use baby powder or massage oil to lubricate and prevent chafing, keep hands warm and avoid wind and cold in winter, and see a doctor for severe symptoms.
